name: my-13--grok-4-7
question: What is the Employment Insurance System (EIS) contribution rate in Malaysia?
answer:
The Employment Insurance System (EIS) in Malaysia is a mandatory social security scheme for most employees.  
Contribution rate: 0.5% of the employee's monthly gross salary paid by the employee, and 0.5% paid by the employer.  
This totals 1% and applies to wages up to RM5,000 per month. Contributions help fund unemployment benefits and related insurance.  
(As of 2024, rates remain unchanged.)
